beats.name: A. 50p
beats.blurb: A loaf of bread costs 50p. Already wrong somehow: horror-film dread in a corner shop.

beats.name: B. £1 → £5
beats.blurb: The next day £1, then £5, the shop darker each time; something unseen is in there.

beats.name: C. £50
beats.blurb: £50. The ghost is inflation: the money printer in the hands of whoever decides that day, never seen.

moodboard_intro: Round 2 (Jack 2026-11-16: "make a bunch of varied ones that look like this image", his photo of a corner-shop doorway at night on cheap colour film). Clean room: three sealed writers, one per beat, fresh web research, nothing from the repo. 15 stills (PR2/CL2/FO2 a-e): street wides, shelf inserts, aisles going dark, an empty counter, a convex mirror, the doorway. Prices: 50p, £1/£5, £50. Nobody in any frame. Round 1's nine looks are still below. Vote This / Maybe / No per still and note any beat.
